cmd: cd /opt/weather-tg && for f in weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_outlook.py; do [ -f $f ] && cp $f $f.bak_outlook; curl -sf -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/$f -o $f.new && mv $f.new $f; done; python3 -m py_compile weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_outlook.py && echo COMPILED; python3 weather_tg_channel.py --dry --digest --ai 2>&1 | tail -70
